slides.texte_overlay:
exquisite words to add to
your vocabulary
(part 3)

poignant
adjective — deeply moving, a little sad
"the last chapter was so poignant i cried."

verbose
adjective — using more words than needed
"my first draft was verbose. the second was clear."

zealous
adjective — full of energy for a cause or goal
"a zealous student before every exam."

ebullient
adjective — cheerful and full of energy
"she was ebullient after getting her results."

meander
verb — to wander slowly, without a clear direction
"my thoughts meander when my phone is near."
